Existing bus routes and operating rights, and a public transport network for Nakhon Ratchasima
se: Meeting on Wednesday 18 November 2026 at 09.30 hrs, Committee Meeting Room CA 333, floor 3, Parliament House. The agenda is to consider the status of existing routes and operating rights: routes in service, routes with no operator, and routes whose licences were not renewed, together with ways to arrange a route network to move public transport forward in Nakhon Ratchasima province, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.
